newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong says holds 49.8 pct Hutchison.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong says holds 49.8 pct Hutchison.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd has raised its stake in Hutchison Whampoa Ltd to 49.8 percent from 49.7 percent, a Cheung Kong spokesman said on Friday.
Cheung Kong has increased its shareholding in Hutchison by 2.06 million shares to 1,929,894,978 shares during the period from April 10 to 15, the spokesman said.

According to a substantial shareholders notifications report from the Hong Kong stock exchange, the 2.06 million Hutchison shares were acquired at prices ranging from HK$55.25 to HK$55.75 during the period April 10 to 15.
Hutchison shares ended at HK$57.25 on Friday.
